name: Materials Informatics & Machine Learning
summary: Applies data science and machine learning to materials discovery, property prediction, characterisation and autonomous experimentation.

topics.name: Materials data: sources, curation, FAIR principles and data quality
Featurising materials: composition descriptors, structure graphs and fingerprints
Graph neural networks for crystals and molecules
Inverse design and generative models for materials
Machine learning for microscopy and diffraction data
Natural-language processing of the materials literature
Pitfalls: data leakage, extrapolation and interpretability
